Name: Add Alert Comment
Author: Admin
Description: Add a comment to alert in Crowdstrike.

Parameters.Description: Specify the ID of the alert that needs to be updated.
Specify the comment for the alert.

AIDescription:
Adds a comment to a specific alert in CrowdStrike Falcon. This action allows analysts to document findings, provide updates, or add context directly to an alert within the CrowdStrike console from within Google SecOps.

### Parameters
| Parameter | Type | Mandatory | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Alert ID | String | Yes | The unique identifier (Composite ID) of the CrowdStrike alert to which the comment will be added. |
| Comment | String | Yes | The text content of the comment to be appended to the alert. |

### Additional Notes
- This action interacts with the CrowdStrike Alerts API v3.
- The comment is appended to the existing list of comments for the specified alert.

### Flow Description
1. **Authentication**: The action authenticates with the CrowdStrike Falcon API using the configured Client ID and Client Secret to obtain a bearer token.
2. **Request Construction**: It prepares a PATCH request payload containing the Alert ID and the comment text, formatted as an `append_comment` action parameter.
3. **API Interaction**: The action sends the request to the CrowdStrike `/alerts/entities/alerts/v3` endpoint.
4. **Response Validation**: The action validates the API response to confirm the comment was successfully added and handles any errors returned by the CrowdStrike platform.
